summary: ANDREASSEN DIGITAL (org. no. 937 009 917) is a sole proprietorship (ENK) based in Sør-Varanger, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2026-01-21. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 62.200 (Konsulentvirksomhet tilknyttet informasjonsteknologi og forvaltning og drift av it-systemer); it has 0 registered employees.

gaps.reason: Legal form ENK is normally not required to file annual accounts in Norway, so none are public.
No LEI is registered with GLEIF for this organisation number (common for companies without traded securities or large financial contracts).
No verified Wikidata item links to this number (normal for smaller companies).
